newsitem.title: USA: Weider debut hurt by weak IPO market.
newsitem.headline: Weider debut hurt by weak IPO market.

text.p: A weak initial public offering market resulted in a lukewarm reception for Weider Nutrition International Inc's shares, an analyst said.

"I was surprised that it priced below range, because it is a good company with solid fundamentals," Ryan Jacob, director of research at the IPO Value Monitor, said about the maker of vitamins and food supplements.
The 5.6 million share offering priced at $11 a share this morning -- sharply below its initial price range of $13.50 to $16.50 a share. The range was later dropped to $11 to $13.
"The pricing is more a case of a weak IPO market than Weider itself," Jacob said.
Weider's shares are trading up 3/8 on 851,600 shares of volume.
